name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A simple pasta dish with a rich tomato and meat sauce.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti.
Fry the onion, garlic and beef.
Add tomato sauce and simmer.
Serve with spaghetti.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Soft homemade pancakes for a quick breakfast.
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients.
Add milk and egg.
Pour batter into a hot pan.
Cook both sides until golden.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Fried rice with chicken, eggs and vegetables.
instructions: Cook the chicken thoroughly.
Scramble the eggs.
Add vegetables and cooked rice.
Mix in soy sauce and stir-fry.

name: Cheese Omelette
description: A quick and easy omelette filled with cheese.
instructions: Beat the eggs with milk.
Melt butter in a pan.
Pour in the eggs.
Add cheese and fold the omelette.

name: Creamy Pasta
description: Pasta mixed with a creamy garlic sauce.
instructions: Boil the pasta.
Cook garlic in butter.
Add cream and parmesan.
Mix the pasta into the sauce.

name: Vegetable Curry
description: A tasty vegetable curry made with coconut milk.
instructions: Chop the vegetables.
Fry onion and curry powder.
Add vegetables and coconut milk.
Simmer until the vegetables are cooked.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: A crispy sandwich with melted cheese inside.
instructions: Butter the bread.
Place cheese between two slices.
Toast in a pan until golden on both sides.

name: Chicken Wrap
description: A tortilla wrap with seasoned chicken and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Season and fully cook the chicken.
Chop the vegetables.
Add everything to the tortilla.
Roll the tortilla into a wrap.

name: Banana Smoothie
description: A refreshing banana smoothie made with milk and honey.
instructions: Peel and slice the banana.
Add everything to a blender.
Blend until smooth and serve.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: A quick chocolate cake made in a mug.
instructions: Mix the dry ingredients in a mug.
Add milk and oil.
Mix until smooth.
Microwave in a microwave-safe mug until cooked.

name: French Toast
description: Golden slices of bread soaked in egg and milk, served with honey.
instructions: Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon together.
Dip each slice of bread into the mixture.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Cook the bread on both sides until golden.
Serve with honey.

name: Overnight Oats
description: Creamy oats prepared the night before with fruit and yogurt.
instructions: Mix the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir in a little honey.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana before eating.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently cooked in a spicy tomato and pepper sauce.
instructions: Chop the onion, pepper and tomatoes.
Cook the onion, garlic and pepper in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and paprika, then simmer until the sauce thickens.
Make small spaces in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the egg whites are set.

name: Breakfast Burrito
description: A warm tortilla filled with eggs, beans and melted cheese.
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a pan with a little butter.
Warm the beans and dice the tomato.
Place the eggs, beans, tomato and cheese on each tortilla.
Fold the sides and roll into a burrito.
Toast lightly in a pan and serve.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Fresh lettuce tossed with chicken, crunchy croutons and creamy dressing.
instructions: Season the chicken and cook it fully in a pan.
Let the chicken rest, then slice it.
Wash and chop the lettuce.
Toss the lettuce with dressing, croutons and parmesan.
Add the chicken slices and serve.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
description: A quick cold pasta salad with tuna, vegetables and a light dressing.
instructions: Boil the pasta and drain it.
Let the pasta cool.
Chop the cucumber and tomatoes.
Mix the pasta with tuna, vegetables, mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Chill briefly before serving.

name: Vegetable Quesadilla
description: Crispy tortillas filled with vegetables and melted cheese.
instructions: Slice the pepper and onion.
Cook the vegetables with a little olive oil until softened.
Add cheese and vegetables to half of each tortilla.
Fold the tortillas and toast in a pan until golden.
Cut into wedges and serve.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl
description: Steamed rice topped with tender chicken and sweet teriyaki sauce.
instructions: Cook the rice according to the packet instructions.
Slice the chicken and cook it thoroughly in a pan.
Steam the broccoli and sliced carrot until tender.
Add teriyaki sauce to the chicken and cook briefly.
Serve over rice with vegetables and sesame seeds.

name: Garlic Butter Salmon
description: Pan-cooked salmon with garlic butter and fresh lemon.
instructions: Season the salmon lightly with salt.
Heat butter in a pan and add minced garlic.
Cook the salmon until it is opaque and flakes easily.
Spoon the garlic butter over the salmon.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

name: Beef Stir Fry
description: Thin strips of beef cooked with colourful vegetables and soy sauce.
instructions: Slice the peppers and chop the broccoli.
Heat oil in a wok and cook the beef strips.
Add garlic, ginger and vegetables.
Stir-fry until the beef and vegetables are cooked.
Add soy sauce, toss well and serve.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Soft, creamy rice with mushrooms and parmesan cheese.
instructions: Chop the mushrooms and onion.
Cook the onion and mushrooms in butter.
Add the rice and stir for a minute.
Pour in warm stock a little at a time, stirring until absorbed.
When the rice is tender, mix in parmesan and serve.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
description: Juicy oven-roasted chicken flavoured with lemon and herbs.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, chopped garlic and herbs.
Coat the chicken with the mixture and place in a baking dish.
Roast until the chicken is fully cooked and reaches 74°C inside.
Rest for a few minutes before serving.

name: Loaded Potato Wedges
description: Crispy potato wedges topped with cheese and spring onions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and paprika.
Bake until golden and tender, turning halfway through.
Sprinkle over cheese and return to the oven until melted.
Top with spring onions and serve with sour cream.

name: Tomato Bruschetta
description: Toasted bread topped with fresh tomato, basil and garlic.
instructions: Slice the baguette and toast until crisp.
Dice the tomatoes and chop the basil.
Mix tomatoes, basil, olive oil and a little salt.
Rub the toast lightly with garlic.
Spoon the tomato mixture over the toast and serve.

name: Hummus with Pita Chips
description: Smooth chickpea dip served with crisp toasted pita pieces.
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and olive oil until smooth.
Add a little water if the hummus is too thick.
Cut pita bread into triangles and toast until crisp.
Serve the hummus with warm pita chips.

name: Strawberry Cheesecake
description: A creamy no-bake cheesecake topped with fresh strawberries.
instructions: Crush the biscuits and mix with melted butter.
Press the mixture into a cake tin and chill.
Beat cream cheese and icing sugar until smooth.
Whip the cream and fold it into the cream cheese mixture.
Spread over the base, chill for several hours and top with strawberries.

name: Chocolate Brownies
description: Rich, fudgy chocolate brownies with a soft centre.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a baking tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, then let them cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then stir in the chocolate mixture.
Fold in the flour and cocoa powder.
Bake until the edges are set, then cool before slicing.

name: Apple Crumble
description: Warm baked apples covered with a buttery, crunchy topping.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C.
Peel and slice the apples, then mix with cinnamon.
Place the apples in a baking dish.
Rub butter into flour, oats and sugar to make a crumbly topping.
Sprinkle over the apples and bake until golden and bubbling.

name: Mango Lassi
description: A chilled mango and yogurt drink with a smooth texture.
instructions: Peel and chop the mango.
Add mango, yogurt, milk and honey to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour over ice and serve cold.

name: Iced Caramel Coffee
description: Cold coffee mixed with milk and a sweet caramel flavour.
instructions: Brew the coffee and let it cool.
Fill a glass with ice cubes.
Pour in the coffee, milk and caramel syrup.
Stir well and top with whipped cream if you like.
